learning_outcomes.text: Understand the effect of the polymerization method on the characteristics of the polymer.
Consolidate the basic principles of polymerization kinetics and develop the ability to predict the macromolecular characteristics of polymers.
Become familiar with macromolecular characterization techniques.
Acquire experience in studying international scientific literature and presenting scientific topics.

syllabus_topics: Polymer microstructure: monomer architecture, orientation, regularity, isomerism
Molecular weight and polydispersity (Free radical polymerization)
Industrial methods of free radical polymerization
Characterization of macromolecules using FTIR, UV/vis, and 1H NMR spectroscopy techniques
teaching_methods: Communication via the Department's website and email
Use of reliable scientific online sources for bibliography and topic presentation

assessment_methods.method: Final written exam (problem solving and essay questions)
Assignment/presentation on a topic from the international literature
Oral exam (for students with learning difficulties)

assessment_rules: Students are assessed through four sets of exercises during the semester, a final written exam, and an assignment/presentation. An oral exam option is available for students with learning difficulties. Students have the right to review their written exam and submit questions to the instructor. The specific method of student assessment and the percentage of each activity in the final grade are described during the first lecture and posted on the course website.
